Azure Firewall Azure Firewall

Cloud-native network security to protect your Azure Virtual Network resources

Updated on：2026/03/11

• Native firewalling capabilities with built-in high availability, unrestricted cloud scalability, and zero maintenance

  • Azure Firewall is a managed cloud-based network security service that protects your Azure Virtual Network resources. Azure Firewall can be seamlessly deployed, requires zero maintenance, and is highly available with unrestricted cloud scalability. Setting up an Azure Firewall is easy; with billing comprised of a fixed and variable fee.

FAQs

Expand all
  • Is a partial hour billed as a full hour?

    Yes. A partial hour is billed as a full hour.

  • Will there be any compute charges in addition to Azure Firewall charges?

    No, you pay for other resources as you normally would. Azure Firewall will not impose any compute charges.

  • How does billing for this service work?

    A fixed hourly fee will be charged per a firewall deployment regardless of scale. In addition, data processing fee is billed per deployment for any data processed by your firewall.

Support & SLA

If you have any questions or need help, please visit Azure Support and select self-help service or any other method to contact us for support.

We guarantee that Azure Firewall will be available at least 99.95% of the time. To learn more about the details of our Service Level Agreement, please visit the Service Level Agreements page.
